What people write down after

The shop on Stevenson

A small-town salon with a big-town book

A nail shop earns a book like this one chair at a time. That doesn’t happen by accident.

T Nails & Spa sits on Stevenson Ave in Enumclaw. It runs six full days plus Sunday afternoons, with several techs working at once — which is why a walk-in on a Saturday morning so often ends with someone waving you into a chair instead of writing you down for next week.

New work goes up on their Facebook page most weeks: a fresh set, a fade, somebody's design finished that afternoon. Until now, that work had nowhere of its own to live.

Getting a chair

Two ways in, both of them easy

  1. Call the shop

    The fastest answer on whether there's an opening this afternoon is a phone call to the front desk.

  2. Or book online

    Appointments run through their booking page — pick a time and it's held for you.

  3. Or just walk in

    Plenty of people do. Mornings and mid-week afternoons are the shortest waits.
